bullish.ema_position: price above 50 EMA and 50 EMA above 200 EMA
bullish.market_structure: higher highs and higher lows, demand zones holding, no recent structural break to downside

bearish.ema_position: price below 50 EMA and 50 EMA below 200 EMA
bearish.market_structure: lower highs and lower lows, supply zones holding, recent break of structure to downside

neutral.ema_position: price between 50 EMA and 200 EMA or EMAs tangled
neutral.market_structure: range-bound price action, no clear directional bias — wait for confirmation

risk_rules.stop_loss: below most recent swing low (long) or above most recent swing high (short)
risk_rules.position_sizing: risk amount divided by distance to stop loss in percentage terms
do_not_trade: within 30 minutes of major macro news events
when daily RSI is above 80 (overextended long) or below 20 (overextended short)
when BTC.D is in extreme flux without clear direction

indicators.name: Volume
indicators.note: above-average volume required to confirm breakouts and entries

long: bullish bias confirmed on daily and weekly
4H pullback to 50 EMA or key support with bullish reaction candle
short: bearish bias confirmed on daily and weekly
4H rally into 50 EMA or key resistance with bearish rejection candle
